name: Kuuko
source:
"Kuu. This person,"is", frightening."

Likes: Fish dishes

A mysterious quiet and expressionless girl.

Due to her often adding the word "Kuu" when speaking which sounds like an animal sound, she was named "Kuuko", and she is staying at the same beach house where [url=/c113574]Kyouhei[/url] lives.

She is usually in a daze and can only speak in a faltering tone.

Also, for some reason, she seems to be attached to Kyouhei, and often sits on his lap immediately when he is at home.

She has a habit of always needing to bite something to compose herself, especially Kyouhei's head and arms which are her favorite things to bite.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/samenana/character/]official website[/url]]
